title.en: Longtime Grooming Service with Recent Friction

text.en: Several longtime customers appreciate the courteous personal care and patience shown when handling energetic dogs over multiple years. However, a recent client expressed frustration with deteriorating customer service and felt unaddressed after reporting grooming concerns.

title.en: Quality Haircuts alongside Inconsistent Face Washing

text.en: Clients generally report sharp, well-executed haircut styling for their pets and praise the neat finishing touches on high-energy breeds. Conversely, a reviewer noted recent inconsistency in grooming thoroughness, reporting persistent tear stains left on their dog's face.

Multiple pet parents find the seventy-dollar grooming charge reasonable and a solid value for full-service care. At the same time, one returning customer pointed out that recent rate increases felt harder to justify when grooming attention did not meet previous expectations.

q.en: How much does a typical grooming session cost?

a.en: Reviewers cite a standard grooming rate of around seventy dollars for small to medium dogs.

q.en: Is the salon capable of handling energetic or difficult dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients note that groomers demonstrate good patience and handle active breeds like Havanese effectively.

q.en: How clean and organized is the salon facility?

a.en: Customers describe the grooming salon as clean, well-maintained, and efficient during pickup and drop-off.
